She also says the US and Israel are "not fully aligned" on Iran, arguing that Washington is focused on reopening the Strait of Hormuz while Israel seeks to weaken Iran more permanently. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

Williams noted that while past tensions have not derailed their relationship, the current talks are shrouded in strategic ambiguity, with speculation about whether the leaders are negotiating a shift in Israel's stance on the Iran conflict or exploring renewed cooperation.  He speaks with Joe Mathieu on the early edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power."
  (Source: Bloomberg)
